I graded submission s2 for quiz 0001 and wrote `grades/0001-s2.json`. Riley got 3 items correct, 2 partial and 1 wrong.

| Item | Verdict | What the grade says |
|---|---|---|
| q1 | correct | The loop is what makes a system an agent. |
| q2 | correct | The model only writes the tool request. |
| q3 | wrong (M6) | Riley chose "left to run longer, it will eventually fix the bug". The agent needs a stopping condition, such as a step limit. |
| q4 | partial (M4) | The count of 4 is right, but the reasoning says the model runs the tools. The program runs them and calls the model again each time. |
| q5 | correct | The result goes back into the model's next input so it can decide its next step. |
| q6 | partial | "By the name" is only part of it. The model uses the whole tool description: name, purpose and parameters. |

**What Riley has down:** the loop, and that the model writes a request instead of running anything.

**To fix:** the model never runs a tool, so each tool run is followed by a new model call. An agent also needs a stopping condition.

**Next step:** write a short description for `check_calendar` (what it does, its parameters, when to use it) and explain how the model would use it. After that we can move on to context and memory.

I also added `learning-records/0003-quiz-0001-who-runs-the-tool.md` and updated `NOTES.md`. `NOTES.md` now says s1 is still ungraded.
